@@ half_orcs
Half-orcs are a hideous creation, born of Man and Orc. The are often confused with Greater Orcs, but are a distinct race, sma in number but capable and deadly. Half-orcs normally ha Hillman blood in them and some are capable of blending in Hillmen societies.

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: Half-orcs are akin to Greater Orcs, but look more like da Men. Males average 150 pounds; females, 135 pounds. Coloring: Black or grey hair, black or reddish-brown eyes. Endurance: They can travel for 2 days without sleep. +10 exhaustion points (see Section 22.3). Height: Males average 5'8"; females, 5'5". Lifespan: Normally 250-500 years. Resistance: +15 DB and RR bonuses versus heat and co attacks. Special Abilities: Half-orcish vision in most darkness is at lea 300'. When there is barely any light (cloudy, moonless night upper caverns, dungeons), Half-orcs can see at least 25' pe fectly and fairly well up to 50'. In absolute darkness, they ca still see 5'.

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: Varies, but leather and metal armor standard with other clothing being depend upon the Orcish Mannish group they are currently associated with. Fears & Inabilities: They perfer to avoid bright sunlit places, b they are not adversely affected by sunlight. Lifestyle: Individual Half-orcs respect power and terror above a things. Their lifestyle is dependent upon the Orcish or Mannis group they are currently associated with. Marriage Pattern: This is normally dependent upon the Orcis or Mannish group they are currently associated with. Religion: Most Half-orcs worship Darkness and power.

@@ ther_actors
Demeanor: Half-orcs are normally cruel, jealous, petty, amb tious, selfish, and suspicious. Language: Starting Languages: Common-speech (S8/W4 Orcish (S8/W4), Black-speech (S4/W3). Allowed Adolescen Development: Common-speech (S10/W8), Orcish (S10/W8 Black-speech (S8/W8), Hill-speech (S6/W6). Prejudices: Half-orcs dislike most races, but they particulari despise Elves and High Men. Professions: No special notes. Special Skills: Everyman: none; Restricted: none.
